author: OpenAI
description:
See what Ben Davis, Peter Gostev, and Tom Krcha are building with GPT-6 Astra, from a playable 3D history of London to new directions for a matcha shop website to solving a DEF CON puzzle with parallel agents.

GPT-6 Astra helps them explore ideas, stay on track, and tackle problems that previously felt out of reach.
title: First impressions of GPT-6 Astra from developers

author: OpenAI
description:
GPT-6 Astra achieves state-of-the-art results on benchmarks for long-running computer-use tasks across professions and desktop apps, which means anything you can do on a computer, Astra can do for you, fast. 

It’s also the best model for software engineering to date and our most aligned model yet, with improvements in honesty and reductions in deceptive behavior.
 
GPT-6 Astra is rolling out today for enterprises and customers in our Trusted Access Program, with broad availability in ChatGPT Work and Codex coming to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise plans, and API and AWS customers in the next few days.

To experience Astra at its best, use the ChatGPT desktop app.

“Put That There" clip courtesy of MIT Media Laboratory, Chris Schmandt, and Eric Hulteen.
title: Introducing GPT-6 Astra: the most intelligent and aligned model in the world.
